comparisons.a3_precise_difference: A3 is a causal checkpoint decision with two-car shared-crew constraints and a deadline-aware hybrid candidate portfolio, scored by an independent simulator evaluator. It does not replace DP race optimisation and does not claim better race times.
comparisons.implemented_evidence: A3 rolling-horizon menu + simulator continuation evaluator
